#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
TARGET_DIR="${HERMCLAW_DISCOVERY_TARGET:-/tmp/hermclaw-detdisc-target}"
DISCOVERY_JSON="${HERMCLAW_DISCOVERY_JSON:-/tmp/hermclaw-benutzerfilter-discovery.json}"
HANDOFF_JSON="${HERMCLAW_HANDOFF_JSON:-/tmp/hermclaw-benutzerfilter-handoff.json}"
MODEL_ALIAS="${HERMCLAW_FAST_ALIAS:-local-coder-qwen3-fast-12k}"
LITELLM_URL="${HERMCLAW_LITELLM_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1/chat/completions}"

cd "$ROOT"

echo "===== CLEAN TARGET CHECKOUT ====="
rm -rf "$TARGET_DIR"
git clone --quiet --single-branch --branch redesign/autonomous-agent \
  git@hermclaw-gitlab:local-ai/hermclaw.git "$TARGET_DIR"
echo "[GIT] Zielbestand: $(git -C "$TARGET_DIR" rev-parse --short HEAD)"

echo
echo "===== DETERMINISTISCHE DISCOVERY ====="
python3 -m model_runtime.deterministic_discovery \
  --root "$TARGET_DIR" \
  --output "$DISCOVERY_JSON"

echo
echo "===== FAST MODELL VORBEREITEN ====="
python3 -m model_runtime.model_manager prepare fast

echo
echo "===== FAST->MAIN HANDOFF ====="
python3 -m model_runtime.fast_handoff \
  --discovery "$DISCOVERY_JSON" \
  --output "$HANDOFF_JSON" \
  --endpoint "$LITELLM_URL" \
  --model "$MODEL_ALIAS"

echo
echo "===== HANDOFF ====="
cat "$HANDOFF_JSON"

echo
echo "===== NÄCHSTER SCHRITT ====="
echo "Wenn target_paths plausibel sind:"
echo "  cd $ROOT"
echo "  python3 -m model_runtime.model_manager prepare main"
echo
echo "Handoff-Datei:"
echo "  $HANDOFF_JSON"
